h:
简单的 Flux-2 文本到图像生成：
此工作流程旨在为您提供一种简单、简化的方式，仅使用文本提示即可使用 Flux 2 生成高质量图像。所有内容都清晰地排列在画布上，因此您可以一目了然地看到正在发生的事情：编写提示，选择宽高比，然后点击“生成...easy peasy”。

它为想要添加自己的 Flux-2 LoRA 的用户提供可选的 LoRA 支持。您还可以根据自己的喜好调整纵横比。

如果您正在为 Flux 2 寻找一个轻量级、易于阅读的起点，或者只是一个干净的模板来构建您自己的工作流程，那么这个模板可以让事情变得简单和稳定。

注意：我在具有 24GB VRAM 的 RTX 4090 上运行此程序，使用此工作流程的生成每个图像大约需要 3 或 4 分钟。

工作流程要求：

1. Flux2_dev_fp8mixed.safetensors（~35GB精简版）
放置在文件夹：ComfyUI\models\diffusion_models

2.flux2-vae.safetensors
放入文件夹：ComfyUI\models\vae

3.mistral_3_small_flux2_fp8.safetensors
放置在文件夹：ComfyUI\models\text_encoders

在这里下载这些：
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/tree/main/split_files

注意：如果您在工作流程中缺少任何节点，只需使用 ComfyUI Manager 搜索它们即可。只需单击“安装缺少的自定义节点”

____________________________

替代型号选项

您还可以使用 65GB 完整 Flux 2 模型而不是 fp8mixed 版本：
https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-dev/tree/main

____________________________

o.en:
Simple Flux-2 Text-to-Image Generation:
This workflow is designed to give you a simple, streamlined way to generate high-quality images with Flux 2 using only a text prompt. Everything is arranged clearly on the canvas so you can see exactly what’s happening at a glance: Write your prompt, choose an aspect ratio, and hit generate...easy peasy.

It includes optional LoRA support for users who want to drop in their own Flux-2 LoRAs. You can also adjust the aspect ratio to your liking.

If you’re looking for a lightweight, easy-to-read starting point for Flux 2 — or just a clean template to build your own workflow from — this one keeps things straightforward and stable.

Note:I'm running this on an RTX 4090 with 24GB VRAM and generations using this workflow take about 3 or 4 minutes per image.

Workflow Requirements:

1. flux2_dev_fp8mixed.safetensors (~35GB lite version)
Place in folder: ComfyUI\models\diffusion_models

2. flux2-vae.safetensors
Place in folder: ComfyUI\models\vae

3. mistral_3_small_flux2_fp8.safetensors
Place in folder: ComfyUI\models\text_encoders

Download these here:
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/flux2-dev/tree/main/split_files

Note:If you're missing any nodes in the workflow, simply search for them using the ComfyUI Manager. Simply click on "Install Missing Custom Nodes"

____________________________

Alternative Model Option

You can also use the 65GB full Flux 2 model instead of the fp8mixed version:
https://huggingface.co/black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-dev/tree/main
